definition: AllJoyn was an open interoperability framework that allowed connected devices to discover and communicate with one another.
entry_text: AllJoyn was an open interoperability framework that allowed connected devices to discover and communicate with one another.
example: A home control app discovers a compatible device on a local network.
label: AllJoyn

sources.note: The standards foundation describes AllJoyn as an open-source interoperability framework for device and app discovery and communication. It says downloads remain available and the project reached its final major release.
